999008199.text: かき氷の注文入ったよ！　急いで！

localizations.en: Another shaved ice order! Hurry up!

999008199.text:
まーたかき氷か。氷削ってシロップかけるだけ。
もっと手の込んだ料理を作らせてほしいよな

localizations.en: Shaved ice again? All you do is scrape some ice and pour syrup on it. I wish I could make something that requires more skill.

999008199.text:
お客さんがたくさんいるんだから文句言わないの。
……って、言いたいところだけど

localizations.en: We've got tons of customers, so quit complaining! ...Though I get where you're coming from.

999008199.text:
せっかく店の垣根を越えて協力してるんだから、
すごいところ見せたいのは確かだよね

localizations.en: Since we're working together across shop lines, I'm sure you want to show off what you can really do.

999008199.text:
あんたの全力、見せてみてよ。
かき氷だってアレンジ次第で化けるでしょ？

localizations.en: So let's see what you've got! Even shaved ice can be amazing with the right touch, right?

999008199.text:
あたしのお客さんさばきで
待ち時間はなんとかしてみせるから

localizations.en: I'll handle the crowd and keep the wait times down with my customer service skills.

999008199.text:
言うじゃねえか。おもしれえ！
イクセルスぺシャルかき氷、見せてやんよ！

localizations.en: Now you're talking! This is gonna be fun! Time to show 'em the Iksel Special shaved ice!

999008199.text: （暑苦しい店ね。冷たいものがさらに売れそうだわ）

localizations.en: (What a sweltering shop. The cold treats should sell even better in this heat.)
